svg.title: Measure reflection before keeping it. If there is a right answer, build a test set of 10 to 15 questions, run each with and without reflection and count the right answers; in Ng's store example, items sold in May came out as 980 without reflection and 1201, the right answer, with it. If there is no right answer, asking an AI which of two charts is better is unreliable because of position bias. Instead, grade one chart at a time against a yes/no checklist; Ng's charts scored 4, 5 and 5 points without reflection and 6, 8 and 7 with it.
